Analyze abstracts of empirical research

Gennaro Baratta rwq421

1 Abstracts selection

I've selected papers that use language models to extract structured information from documents, excluding work focused on optical character recognition (OCR) itself. I aimed to include research on layout-aware extraction and source-evidence localization. I identified related papers using chatGPT alongside research tools such as Consensus and Undermind plugins, with keywords including structured information extraction , LLM document extraction , layout-aware extraction , schema-guided extraction , evidence grounding , and scientific information extraction , restricting the selection to publications from the last year due to the rapid pace of development in the field. From these results, I selected the ones with empirical evaluations that were sufficiently related to support a meaningful comparison. I excluded papers focused primarily on OCR, generic document understanding.

1.1 Selected papers

| Selected papers                                                                                                           | Domain                                                                             | Empirical approach                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| A Multistage Extraction Pipeline for Long Scanned Financial Documents: An Empirical Study in Industrial KYC Workflows [1] | Multimodal information extraction; industrial compliance.                          | Evaluation of a multistage extraction pipeline on about 3000 scanned multilingual pages. They compare several combinations against PDF-to-VLM baselines and remove each component to determine its contribution. |
| VAREX: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal Structured Extraction from Documents [2]                                               | Multimodal information extraction; benchmarking.                                   | Synthetic construction of a dataset producing deterministic ground truth. Benchmark comprises 1798 documents combining four different input representation, enabling systematic ablation.                        |
| SchemaRAG: Dynamic Large Schema Reduction for LLM-driven Structured Information Extraction [3]                            | information extraction; retrival-augmented generation.                             | comparative study on how the complexity of schema could hinder accuracy. Evaluation on real-world healthcare and e-commerce dataset.                                                                             |
| VLM-guided key information extraction for Chinese visually-rich documents [4]                                             | information extraction; explainable document understanding; evidence localization. | architectural evaluation based on benchmarking against prior systems.                                                                                                                                            |
| Visual information extraction from documents via classification-guided large vision-language models [5]                   | Visual information extraction; VLLM.                                               | evaluation of dynamic prompts on real-world bidding dataset, comparing with supervised baseline.                                                                                                                 |
